scope: Actual private geometry observation probes; full keyframe measurement/viewport/projection/Card acceptance remains separately mandatory

rows.name: identity-and-local-bounds
rows.setup: Use a fresh frozen matching consumer/native product and the private geometry scene; capture native SDK inspection and exact identities.
rows.action: Query the unchanged owned view.
rows.expected: Record the actual native owner/binding/tag/window/scope/epoch/root identity, density, finite local/window boxes and platform matrix format; compare with the same SDK view inspection.

rows.name: mount-before-after
rows.setup: Use a fresh frozen matching consumer/native product and the private geometry scene; capture native SDK inspection and exact identities.
rows.action: Change owned layout, then sample.
rows.expected: One actual matching mount cohort retains before and after geometry/commit revisions with increasing sequence; no initial before rectangle is fabricated.

rows.name: owned-transform
rows.setup: Use a fresh frozen matching consumer/native product and the private geometry scene; capture native SDK inspection and exact identities.
rows.action: Change owned transform, then sample.
rows.expected: Actual translated/rotated/scaled model quadrilateral differs from the untransformed box, including the authored9.25-point/dp subpixel translation.

rows.name: ancestor-transform
rows.setup: Use a fresh frozen matching consumer/native product and the private geometry scene; capture native SDK inspection and exact identities.
rows.action: Move actual ancestor, then sample.
rows.expected: Window geometry changes when the native ancestor moves even though the target own layout is unchanged.

rows.name: ancestor-scroll
rows.setup: Use a fresh frozen matching consumer/native product and the private geometry scene; capture native SDK inspection and exact identities.
rows.action: Scroll actual ancestor, then sample.
rows.expected: Actual ancestor scroll offsets and current window geometry agree without resetting the scroll position.

rows.name: presentation
rows.setup: Use a fresh frozen matching consumer/native product and the private geometry scene; capture native SDK inspection and exact identities.
rows.action: Inspect before/after actual display frames.
rows.expected: UIKit returns actual presentation-layer data when available and explicit null otherwise; Android reports actual View/RenderNode matrix provenance without claiming GPU presentation time.

rows.name: clipping
rows.setup: Use a fresh frozen matching consumer/native product and the private geometry scene; capture native SDK inspection and exact identities.
rows.action: Inspect a rounded/overflow/custom-clip ancestor.
rows.expected: Native clip/path/outline data and completeness remain truthful; unresolved Android RN padding paths or arbitrary masks cannot satisfy full clipping/viewport acceptance.

rows.name: retire-and-replace
rows.setup: Use a fresh frozen matching consumer/native product and the private geometry scene; capture native SDK inspection and exact identities.
rows.action: Remove and restore the actual owner between requests.
rows.expected: Old binding/ref/window/epoch/query revisions do not publish into the replacement owner; actual native detach identity is retained for retirement.

rows.name: held-editor
rows.setup: Use a fresh frozen matching consumer/native product and the private geometry scene; capture native SDK inspection and exact identities.
rows.action: Exercise layout/transform/scroll queries while the held editor remains empty.
rows.expected: Original editor/root refs and methods, controlled empty value/selection, and editor request counts remain unchanged.

rows.name: window-rotation
rows.setup: Use a fresh frozen matching consumer/native product and the private geometry scene; capture native SDK inspection and exact identities.
rows.action: Rotate/change the actual native window using the authorized transport.
rows.expected: Native window/root/epoch/geometry revisions describe the new actual coordinate space; old requests cannot drive it.

rows.name: unknown-capability
rows.setup: Use a fresh frozen matching consumer/native product and the private geometry scene; capture native SDK inspection and exact identities.
rows.action: Request/inspect unavailable presentation or incomplete clipping.
rows.expected: Private capability checks reject explicitly; no model box is relabelled as missing presentation or complete clipping.

rows.name: large-tree-cost
rows.setup: Use a fresh frozen matching consumer/native product and the private geometry scene; capture native SDK inspection and exact identities.
rows.action: Mount the approved eventual large motion tree and collect native frame/memory observations.
rows.expected: Record actual observer, mount, rendering, JS-bridge and display-frame costs; no source timing is promoted as native performance.

rows.setup: Apply the actual required profile using the authorized transport, retaining the producer/window/editor identity.
rows.action: Reach both query controls and repeat actual layout/transform/ancestor-scroll measurements.
rows.expected: Finite actual current coordinate/matrix/epoch data and reachable controls agree with native SDK observation; no editor/ref write, synthetic rectangle or desktop assumption substitutes for this profile.
